Take the 75 planets with the lowest crime rates. Look at them now. They're up 19%.''"
"''We can all game the numbers, Mon. But whose numbers are they? I believe what I feel.|Mon Mothma and the senator|audio=BelieveWhatIFeel-Andor.mp3|}} A [[Tarsunt]] served as a '''senator''' in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Senate]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[3 BBY]], they met with [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] on the Empire's [[capital]] [[planet]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[Coruscant]] while she attempted to get votes in the Senate to challenge [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine's]] extension of the [[Public Order Resentencing Directive]]. During the meeting, Mothma presented crime rate numbers rising by nineteen percent within the top seventy-five [[planet]]s with formerly the lowest counts [[5 BBY|two years]] prior. The Tarsunt rejected the numbers, questioning whose numbers they were and stated that all senators could game the numbers to make their points. Instead, they chose to believe what they felt. They had [[color|yellow]] skin, black [[eye]]s, and white [[hair]]. When meeting Mothma, they wore a long purple [[robe]] with a light purple and [[gold]] [[belt]]. ==Behind the scenes== The senator first appeared in "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]," the fourth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} Before their appearance in the episode, the Tarsunt was first pictured in ''[[Andor Season 2: A Special Look]]'', a [[Disney+]] documentary{{SWYouTube|feJSTZRRaFQ|Andor Season 2 | Special Look | Streaming April 22 on Disney+|int=Andor Season 2: A Special Look}} released on [[March 4]], 2025{{WebCite|url=https://gizmodo.com/star-wars-andor-season-2-special-look-ghorman-massacre-disney-plus-2000571971|text=A New Look at ''Andor'' Season 2 Confirms a Major Star Wars Event|work=[[Wikipedia:Gizmodo|''Gizmodo'']]|archivedate=20250305155833}} providing an early look at the series. The Tarsunt was portrayed by [[Derek Arnold]] and was listed in the episode's credits as "Senator #3." The costume for the senator was developed by costume designer [[Michael Wilkinson]]'s team,{{Instagram|username=michaelwilkinson|url=p/DMqEpKRxK0V/?img_index=5|name=[[Michael Wilkinson]]|date=2025-07-29|quote=Two of my favorite things about designing #Andor was working with the industry leader in visual effects, Industrial Light & Magic, overseen by Mohen Leo, as well as the legendary Neal Scanlan, head of creature and droid effects for the series. Both of them are geniuses and all around nice guys. They helped us achieve a beautiful fusion of costume, visual effects, and creatures.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/P0ogq}} overseen by visual effects supervisor [[Mohen Leo]] and head of creature and droid effects [[Neal Scanlan]]. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|feJSTZRRaFQ|Andor Season 2 | Special Look | Streaming April 22 on Disney+|int=Andor Season 2: A Special Look}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|q0trVP56Cy0|Star Wars Celebration LIVE! 2025 - DAY 2}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი ტარსუნტი სენატორი }} [[Category:Galactic Empire senators]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Tarsunt]]
